title: Coverage Matchmaker — one-off cross-functional census
content:
Sheet: Cross-functional liaison census (one-off)

Columns: Liaison | Team | Primary contact | Role | Region | Timezone | Typical weekly hours | Current coverage % | Known single-points | Suggested backup (tz aware) | Urgency (1-5) | Last sync date | Quick note

Rows:
1) Liaison: Marcus Chen | Team: Eng - Serving Runtime | Primary contact: marcus@redwood.ai | Role: Runtime perf owner | Region: NA | Timezone: PST | Typical weekly hours: 14 | Current coverage %: 65 | Known single-points: nightly-batch alert triage | Suggested backup: Riley Morgan (PST/EST overlap) | Urgency: 4 | Last sync date: 2024-09-10 | Quick note: prefers async handoff; can be paged for high-severity regressions.

2) Liaison: Riley Morgan | Team: Platform Engineering | Primary contact: riley@redwood.ai | Role: Burst/autoscale steward | Region: NA/EU | Timezone: EST | Typical weekly hours: 10 | Current coverage %: 70 | Known single-points: burst policy tuning doc ownership | Suggested backup: Elena García (EU morning) | Urgency: 3 | Last sync date: 2024-09-12 | Quick note: can own weekend surge plan with 24h notice.

3) Liaison: Elena García | Team: Customer Success | Primary contact: elena@redwood.ai | Role: Customer handoffs & SLAs | Region: EU | Timezone: CEST | Typical weekly hours: 20 | Current coverage %: 80 | Known single-points: enterprise handoff notes not centralized | Suggested backup: Rotating CS on-call (CE) | Urgency: 5 | Last sync date: 2024-09-15 | Quick note: recommends single canonical handoff doc per account.

4) Liaison: Priya Rao | Team: Product - Hosted API | Primary contact: priya@redwood.ai | Role: API product lead | Region: APAC | Timezone: IST | Typical weekly hours: 8 | Current coverage %: 45 | Known single-points: region-specific quota exemptions | Suggested backup: Alex Wu (APAC overlap) | Urgency: 2 | Last sync date: 2024-09-05 | Quick note: low weekly time but critical for feature flag flips.

5) Liaison: Samir Desai | Team: Observability | Primary contact: samir@redwood.ai | Role: Telemetry owner | Region: NA | Timezone: MST | Typical weekly hours: 12 | Current coverage %: 60 | Known single-points: dashboard thresholds tuned by hand | Suggested backup: Observability rotation (oncall) | Urgency: 3 | Last sync date: 2024-09-08 | Quick note: will provide short-run dashboard recipes.

Summary notes:
- Immediate gaps: APAC product liaison coverage is lowest (Priya at 45%). Suggest one additional 4–6 hour/week backup or a rotating on-call window for common deployment windows (UTC+5 to +8).
- Critical single-points: centralizing enterprise handoff docs (Elena) and automated alerts for nightly-batch triage (Marcus) are top-2 mitigations to reduce mean-time-to-ack.
- Quick wins (1–2 week): pair Marcus + Observability to wire an automated triage pager rule (ticket: RED-4672), create a single enterprise-handoff template and add to Confluence playbook, establish an APAC 4-hour rotating window and trial for 30 days.

Actions & owners (mini tracker):
- Aisha: draft APAC rotating window proposal (due 2024-09-30)
- Marcus + Samir: prototype batch-triage pager (create PR and test in canary by 2024-10-07)
- Elena: produce canonical enterprise handoff template and add to Confluence (due 2024-09-29)
- Riley: coordinate weekend surge trial schedule and ops runbook (due 2024-10-03)

Open questions / risks:
- If backups are assigned but not trained, coverage will still be brittle; propose 1-hour micro-runbook per liaison to onboard backups.
- Timezone overlaps: current suggested backups rely on informal overlaps; consider small stipend or shift for prioritized accounts during trial.

Notes to self (Aisha): this is a throwaway census for the September handoff push — keep it lightweight. Convert to a recurring quarterly census if trial shows improvement. Link artifacts: RED-4672 (pager rule), Coverage Playbook confluence page, runtime PR #981 for telemetry hook.

Revision history:
- 2024-09-18 created initial rows and outreach list
- 2024-09-20 added Samir and Priya rows after outreach
- 2024-09-25 updated suggested backups and set action due dates
